Sergio Mattarella ( Italian: [ˈsɛrdʒo mattaˈrɛlla] ; born 23 July 1941) is an Italian politician who has been serving as the president of Italy since 2015. He is the longest-serving president in the history of the Italian Republic . Since Giorgio Napolitano 's death in 2023, Mattarella is the only living Italian president. [ 1 ]
